name: Karnataka
intro: Hampi's boulder-strewn ruins, the Chalukya temples of Badami, Aihole and Pattadakal, Hoysala masterpieces at Belur, Halebidu and Somanathapura, Mysuru's palace and Dasara, tiger forests of Nagarhole and Bandipur, coffee hills of Coorg and Chikkamagaluru, and a coast of temples and beaches.

trails.name: Hampi in depth
trails.note: The ruins, the river and Anegundi across it.

trails.name: Chalukya heartland
trails.note: Badami's caves and the temples where Indian temple building began.

trails.name: Deccan sultanates
trails.note: Domes, madrasas and forts of Bijapur, Gulbarga and Bidar.

trails.name: Hoysala circuit
trails.note: Three UNESCO temples and the great Bahubali.

trails.name: Mysuru and the Kaveri
trails.note: Palaces, Tipu's island and river birds.

trails.name: Coorg
trails.note: Coffee, waterfalls, a golden temple and the Kaveri's source.

trails.name: Malnad coffee hills
trails.note: Peaks, temples and plantations of Chikkamagaluru.

trails.name: The coastal road
trails.note: Temple towns, beaches and islands from Mangaluru to Karwar.

trails.name: Sharavathi and Agumbe
trails.note: Jog Falls, rainforest and the Western Ghats.

trails.name: Around Bengaluru
trails.note: Hills, forts and temples for a day out.
